title: Editor Crash when setting TextureRect scale (within very specific node arrangements)
body:
### Tested versions

 - v4.6.3.stable.nixpkgs [35e80b3a8]
 - v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4] ~> ArchLinux

### System information

Happend on nixos and arch, both using kde wayland. I have prefer wayland on, the other person has not.

### Issue description

Given some highly specific node configurations, setting a TextureRect expand mode to fit height will crash the Editor. Godots terminal output will show a `Object was deleted while awaiting a callback.` spam before it crashes.

I will say this issue is quite specific. My coworker has found this in the wild while working on our game and the setup included in here is the smallest I could get it.

I'd say it is not that urgent to fix, as there are many workarounds to prevent this crash and you have to do some specific arrangements to stumble into it. Maybe it is also not that difficult to fix.

Almost certainly related to #108407, but I did not manage to reproduce their issue using TextureRects.

### Steps to reproduce

1. open example Project
2. open crashout.tscn
3. click on the `TextureRect` labelled SetToFitHeight
4. Set it's expand mode to FIT_HEIGHT

## How to not reproduce
This seems to be a very specific crash that will not occur under a bunch of circumstances. These are some of the modifications you can to do the MRP to make it not crash.

 - Add a control node and set it as scene root
 - Set the expand mode to ignore size
 - Replacing the Mischief Texture with a Label
 - Setting the expand mode of Mischief to fit width instead of fit with proportional

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[texturerect-crash-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30542350/texturerect-crash-bug.zip)
